notes.title: Monster Taming Direct 2025 + Demo Update 1.2.2
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141845/96bae00ffa0fa50923846396b881a132fc1e7a3d.png"][/img][/p][p]Version 1.2.2 of the Insectile Demo is here![/p][p][/p][p]This update implements new animations to match the ones shown off in [b]Monster Taming Direct 2025![/b] If you have not seen the direct, I highly recommend you watch it [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fe0pgU-LvDM"]here![/url] [i](Thank you so much to Gym Leader Ed for selecting Insectile to be a part of the event!)[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Animations[/h3][list][*][p]Taming now triggers a new animation where a jar clunks down over the target Insectile.[/p][/*][*][p]Morphing now triggers a new animation where the target Insectile wraps itself in silk.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Glitches[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a glitch where a lily pad in the Muddy Poppy Patch would disappear.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any feedback on the demo![/p][p][/p][p]I hope you all enjoy![/p]
